versions.changelog: 修复 AI 驱动版 GWT 验收标准自动生成逻辑（v2.0 引入的 bug），清理 10 个废弃脚本，集成 MarkItDown 文档解析
v2.6.0: 基于 Claude Code 技巧优化文档结构，添加快速开始、正误对比示例、FAQ 和版本历史
新增建议分级体系、自动安装依赖、系统对接检查项

v2.4 introduces smarter API configuration and improved user guidance.

- New: Intelligent API configuration guide with automatic detection and saving of all available providers.
- Enhanced: First-time use guides you through directory and API setup; configuration is automatically saved and reused.
- Improved: One-click detection of available API settings; no need to manually reconfigure each time.
- Supports both single-file and batch requirement checks, with optional summary reports.
- Maintains gentle, suggestion-based feedback style for all recommendations.
